hazards.control: Bleed the tubing and casing to zero and verify before breaking any connection.

name: Controller and motor valve
function: The solar-powered controller that opens and closes the flowline motor valve on time or pressure to cycle the plunger.

tabs.overview: Reads casing and tubing pressure and the arrival sensor; adjusts shut-in and flow times.
tabs.engineering: Pneumatic or electric motor valve on the flowline.
tabs.safety: Low voltage; flowline pressure at the valve.
tabs.evidence: PetroWiki sucker-rod lift, ESP, and gas lift pages (S39, S40, S41); API 11AX, 11E, 11S, 11V (S43 to S46); field practice (S9). Generic geometry; not an OEM design.
